scratch_policy.CommonHash: input_len u64 words; query batch and insertion batch computed independently
scratch_policy.DirectRaw8: zero words and zero allocation; no identity copy
scratch_policy.complete_build_clock: starts before required scratch allocation/initialization and F::new; ends after raw insertion
scratch_policy.raw_insert_clock: starts when scratch and filter are ready; retains all required hashing and public insertion
scratch_policy.lifetime: each build scratch is released after that build validation, before next build/query; canonical build scratch also dropped before query

insert_batch_policy: Independent configurable parameter; neither whole-input nor4096 is selected as the sole optimum. The later finite execution protocol must fix it before data.
output_validation: Before every timed query (outside clock), warmup, build-validation chunk and calibration chunk, poison its output region with non-0/1; validate full outputs/guards after call. Required actual-caller faults: skip-last-write and wrong-value.
